content.short: Fractal ID provides a crypto native identity provider with over 1M users and is trusted by 250+ dapps across 8 blockchains.
content.description: Fractal ID delivers an interoperable, decentralized identity system built for Web3. Its identity stack supports chain-agnostic verification, including KYC, KYB, and Proof of Personhood, helping projects validate users while preserving privacy. By simplifying the entire identity workflow, Fractal ID enhances interoperability across networks and supports broader adoption of decentralized identity within Web3 ecosystems.
content.meta: Fractal ID is the interoperable decentralized identity system for Web3. Discover Fractal ID and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
